For an ordinary sign reference use that sign directly. Neither co-lord is added as a virtual occupant.

jaimini/chara-dasha/kn-rao-candidate.yam.antardashas: Divide major period into twelve. Start one sign forward for Aries, Leo, Virgo, Libra, Aquarius and Pisces; otherwise start one backward. Continue in the same direction and end with parent sign.
jaimini/chara-dasha/kn-rao-candidate.yam.duration: For an even-footed period sign count backward to its lord, otherwise forward. Subtract one from inclusive count; replace zero with twelve. Add one for exalted lord or subtract one for debilitated lord under this implementation. Keep dual-lord selection explicit.
jaimini/chara-dasha/kn-rao-candidate.yam.review: Compare to the intended edition and confirm sign-lord variant. Owner selection pending.
jaimini/chara-dasha/kn-rao-candidate.yam.start: Begin at Lagna. If the ninth sign from Lagna is even-footed, visit signs backward, otherwise forward.

jaimini/chara-dasha/periods.yaml.duration: Subtract one from the inclusive sign count; use twelve years when ruler occupies the sign itself. Dual-lord, exaltation and debility adjustments depend on selected school.
jaimini/chara-dasha/periods.yaml.hold: K.N. Rao or alternate variant and worked example must be explicitly pinned before dated output.
jaimini/chara-dasha/periods.yaml.start: Use natal Lagna sign in the candidate profile. Store direction by sign group and count to its ruler with the specified direct/reverse convention.

jaimini/chara-karakas/methods.yaml.eight: Add Rahu using 30° minus its intra-sign longitude; insert paternal karaka between MK and PK. Resolve ties with full precision or hold the rank.
jaimini/chara-karakas/methods.yaml.karakamsa: Read the sign of the ranked Atmakaraka in D9. Keep D9 reference and any projection to D1 explicitly labelled.
jaimini/chara-karakas/methods.yaml.rank: Normalize sidereal longitude modulo a turn, then take the remainder modulo one sign. Sort descending without rounding. Rahu alone uses sign width minus remainder, including the full width at zero. Ordinary retrogression does not reverse any other graha.
jaimini/chara-karakas/methods.yaml.selection: Require an explicit scheme on the chart.
jaimini/chara-karakas/methods.yaml.seven: Rank Sun through Saturn by degrees traversed in their current signs, descending. AK, AmK, BK, MK, PK, GK, DK.

steps: If exactly one candidate is in the owned sign, select the other. If both occupy it, use the classical ruler for this profile.
Prefer more other grahas occupying the candidate's sign. Use the nine classical grahas and exclude the candidate itself.

Prefer more connections from Jupiter, Mercury and the classical dispositor of the occupied sign. Test occupation or Jaimini sign aspect. Count roles separately even when Mercury or Jupiter also disposits. Classical dispositors prevent recursion.
Prefer an exalted candidate under the selected dignity profile. Mars exalts in Capricorn and Saturn in Libra. Nodal exaltations are unassigned in this profile.
Prefer the candidate occupying a dual sign, then fixed, then movable.

For Chara dasha compare the two candidate durations using the selected direction and dignity adjustments. For arudhas or a lord-based argala reference compare unrounded progress within the sign, measured from the sign's end for either node.
jaimini/lordship/dual-lords.yaml.tie: Withhold a dependent selection if all applicable comparisons tie or required data are missing.
jaimini/lordship/dual-lords.yaml.traditions_differ: Some schools always use Mars and Saturn. Nodal exaltations and the final tie-break vary. The longer-period test belongs to the period calculation only.

jaimini/rashi-drishti/signs.yaml.movable: Aspect every fixed sign except the adjacent one.
jaimini/rashi-drishti/signs.yaml.propagation: Grahas in the aspecting sign participate. Keep separate from full graha drishti.
